content: Next.js 16.3.0 is current stable. App Router is the default. Path-based i18n uses app/[lang]/ segment pattern with a middleware/proxy.ts for locale negotiation and redirect. Next.js docs recommend next-intl as the primary i18n library. The middleware file is now called proxy.ts in Next.js 16. generateStaticParams in root layout generates static locale routes. next/root-params provides a lang() getter for accessing locale in Server Components without prop drilling.
